<function=python>
<parameter=code>
a = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
print("timer:", sum(1 for c in a[0] if c=='N'))
def barpos(fr):
    aa = fr.ascii.split('\n')
    px = [(r,c) for r in range(64) for c in range(64) if aa[r][c]=='b']
    return (min(p[0] for p in px), max(p[0] for p in px), min(p[1] for p in px), max(p[1] for p in px))
print("bar now:", barpos(current_frame))
action(['LEFT']*5)
print("after LEFTx5:", barpos(current_frame))
action(['UP'])
print("after UP:", barpos(current_frame), "changed:", last_action_result.get('board_changed'))
</parameter>
</function>
